id: title:Piccirello:reject proxy domains that posthog itself owns

review.posthog_relevance: Adds a domain reservation check to the proxy record provisioning and retry workflows, potentially preventing users from provisioning domains owned by PostHog.
review.reason: The chunk demonstrates the addition of checks against a reserved domain function (`is_reserved_proxy_domain`) in three hunks: an import, a serializer validation, and a retry endpoint. This establishes the implementation of a safeguard against provisioning reserved domains. However, the chunk does not contain the definition of the `RESERVED_PROXY_DOMAINS` set or the implementation,;
